values: Verify that guests, clients, freelancers and administrators can browse forum categories and posts, publish and maintain their own posts, interact through likes and comments, and report inappropriate content. The cases below cover the forum use cases UC-04.1 to UC-04.17.

1. Open the Forum page.
2. Observe the category list returned by GET /api/backend/forums/categories.
HTTP 200. All categories with deletedAt = null are returned with id, name, slug, description, createdAt, updatedAt and postCount. Deleted categories are not present.
The system is connected to the database and at least one active category exists.
Category with no posts is still listed

1. Prepare an active category that has no posts.
2. Open the Forum page.
3. Locate the empty category.
The empty category is returned in the list with postCount = 0. No error is raised.
The system is connected to the database and at least one active category exists.

1. Soft-delete every forum category in the database.
2. Request GET /api/backend/forums/categories.
HTTP 200 with an empty array. The page shows the empty-state message instead of an error.
The system is connected to the database and at least one active category exists.

1. Stop the database or revoke the connection.
2. Request GET /api/backend/forums/categories.
HTTP 500 with FailedToLoadForumCategoriesException. The page shows a retry message and no partial data.
The system is connected to the database and at least one active category exists.
View an existing category by id

1. Select a category from the category list.
2. Request GET /api/backend/forums/categories/{id}.
HTTP 200 with the category id, name, slug, description, timestamps and postCount. The detail page shows the category name and description.
The system is connected to the database and the requested category exists.
Category detail reflects only non-deleted posts

1. Create three posts in a category.
2. Soft-delete one post.
3. Open the category detail.
postCount equals 2. The deleted post is excluded from the count and from the category post preview.
The system is connected to the database and the requested category exists.
HTTP 404 with ForumCategoryNotFoundException. The page shows a not-found message and a link back to the category list.
The system is connected to the database and the requested category exists.
HTTP 400 from ParseIntPipe validation. The request is rejected before reaching the service.
The system is connected to the database and the requested category exists.
View the first page of posts

1. Open the Forum page.
2. Request GET /api/backend/forums/posts?page=1&limit=10.
HTTP 200. The response contains at most 10 non-deleted posts with author profile, category, likeCount and commentCount, plus pagination {page:1, limit:10, total, totalPages}.
The system is connected to the database and approved posts exist.
Filter posts by category and search keyword
HTTP 200. Only posts in the selected category whose title or content matches 'escrow' are returned. Pagination total matches the filtered result.
The system is connected to the database and approved posts exist.

1. Request page=1&limit=1.
2. Request the last page.
3. Request page beyond the last page.
limit=1 returns exactly one post. The last page returns the remaining posts. A page beyond totalPages returns an empty posts array with the correct total and totalPages.
The system is connected to the database and approved posts exist.

1. Request page=0.
2. Request limit=-5.
3. Request categoryId=abc.
Each request returns HTTP 400 from Zod validation. No query is executed against the database.
The system is connected to the database and approved posts exist.

1. Select a post from the post list.
2. Request GET /api/backend/forums/posts/{id}.
HTTP 200 with id, title, slug, content, category, author profile, moderationStatus = APPROVED, moderationScore, createdAt and updatedAt.
The post exists, is not deleted, and the database is reachable.
View a post without a category

1. Create a post without categoryId.
2. Open its detail.
HTTP 200. The category field is null and the UI hides the category breadcrumb without throwing an error.
The post exists, is not deleted, and the database is reachable.
View a deleted or non-existent post

1. Soft-delete a post.
2. Request GET /api/backend/forums/posts/{id}.
3. Repeat with an unknown id.
HTTP 404 with ForumPostNotFoundException. The page shows a not-found message and does not leak the deleted content.
The post exists, is not deleted, and the database is reachable.

1. Request GET /api/backend/forums/posts/by-slug/{slug} for an existing post.
2. Repeat with an unknown slug.
The existing slug returns HTTP 200 with the same detail payload. The unknown slug returns HTTP 404 with ForumPostNotFoundException.
The post exists, is not deleted, and the database is reachable.
Create a post with title, content and category

1. Sign in as a client or freelancer.
2. Submit POST /api/backend/forums/posts with a valid categoryId, title and content.
HTTP 201 with the created post. The post is persisted with the current userId, a generated unique slug, moderationStatus from the AI moderation result (PENDING when absent), and the timestamps.
The user is authenticated and the database is reachable.
Create a post without a category
1. Submit a post with title and content only.
HTTP 201. categoryId is null and the post is created successfully.
The user is authenticated and the database is reachable.

1. Submit a title and content of exactly 1 character.
2. Submit a very long title and content within the UI limit.
Both requests succeed because the schema only requires min(1). The stored values match the submitted text without truncation.
The user is authenticated and the database is reachable.

1. Submit without title.
2. Submit with title = ''.
3. Submit with content = ''.
Each request returns HTTP 400 with the FORUM_POST_TITLE_REQUIRED or FORUM_POST_CONTENT_REQUIRED validation message. No post is created.

HTTP 200. Only the title changes; content and category remain unchanged.

1. Submit PATCH for id 999999.

The AI pipeline can verify the document from the front side alone.

HTTP 201 Created. status = REJECTED, aiStatus = REJECTED, reviewNotes = "Document is blurry" and aiScore is stored. The user sees the rejection reason and may resubmit.
The AI service is reachable and returns a REJECTED verdict.
